name: Nama Hame!! Lolita Satsueiki
original_name: 生ハメっ!! ロリータ撮影記
source:
The protagonist one day met a young girl, Misaki Tachibana, at a manga cafe.
Every day he slicked up girls like her with his words, and brought them home.
The shoot started innocently with Misaki, but he couldn't help himself
and began to secretly film a sex tape...
